lede: Texas A&M carries the stronger underlying team rating — +11.7 against +9.2, a 2.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it LSU +1.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Texas A&M winning 53% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Texas A&M leads LSU by 60 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
